question: Estimate the number of mobile phone retailers (organized + unorganized) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All retailers selling mobile phones (organized chains + standalone shops)? Yes.
Excluding online-only resellers? Yes — physical only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Brand-exclusive (Mi Stores, OnePlus Experience, OPPO/Vivo authorized): ~5,000.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~6-7 lakh mobile phone retailers pan-India.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average sales per retailer per year
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~150-250 units (varies hugely; small shops do ~100, large multi-brand do ~5,000).

calculationFlow: - Organized chains (Croma, Reliance Digital, Vijay Sales, Sangeetha Mobiles, Poorvika, Big C, Lot Mobiles): ~2,000.
- Multi-brand small retailers / mobile shops: ~6 lakh.
Round: ~6-7 lakh mobile phone retailers pan-India.
